chapter.verse: Tua laitak Jesu' kiangah nungzuite hong pai uh a, “Vantung kumpigam sungah kua thupipen ahi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in naupangno khat samin amau' laizang ah a koih khit ciangin hih bangin gen hi:
“Maantak kong cihin ah note kikhelin naupangte tawh na kibat kei uhleh vantung kumpigam na lut ngeikei ding uh hi.
Hih naupang bangin amahmah a kiniamkhiat peuhpeuh vantung kumpigam sungah a thupipen ahi hi.
Hih bang naupang khat keima' min tawh a sang peuhpeuh kei hong sang hi a,
ahi zongin kei hong um hih naupangnote khat a khialh nadingin a bawl peuhpeuh a ngawng ah an-gawina suang khat ok henla tuipi laizang ah tumsuk hileh ama' ading hoihzaw lai ding hi.
“Palkhaktheih thute huhau-in leitung a dahhuaizia! A hang pen palkhaktheih thute hong pailoh a phamawh hi a, ahih hangin tuate hong tun nadinga kizang mi ahihleh a dahhuaizia!

Tua hi a, na khut ahihkeileh na khe in nang hong khialsak ahihleh sattan inla paaimang in. Khut kim khe kim tawh tawntung meili sung hong kikhiatsuk ding sangin khut langkhat khe langkhat tawh nuntakna sung na lut ding hoihzaw hi.
Na mit in nang hong khialsak ahihleh khelkhia inla paaimang in. Mittang nih tawh hell meili sung hong kikhiatsuk ding sangin mit langkhat tawh nuntakna sung na lut ding hoihzaw hi.
“Hih naupangte khatpeuh na etneu loh ding uh kidawm un. Ke'n maantak kong cihin ah vantung ah amau' vanmite in vantunga om ka Pa' maitang a tawntungin mu uh hi.
(A hang pen a mangthangte a honkhia dingin Mihing' Tapa a hong pai ahi hi.)
Na bangci ngaihsut uh hiam? Mi khat in tuu zakhat nei henla tuate lakah khat lampial hileh mualtung-a sawmkua-le-kuate nusia-in tua a lampial pen a zong dingin va pai ding hilo ahi hiam?
Maantak kong cihin ah tua a lampial tuu a muh leh tua hanga a lungdamna pen lampial ngeilo sawmkua-le-kuate' hanga a lungdamna sangin lianzaw hi.
Tua mah bangin vantunga om ka Pa in hih naupangte khat nangawn a kisiat ding deih lo hi.
“Nang' tungah na sanggampa hong khialh leh pai inla note gel bek na om laitakun a khialhna va gen in. Na thu hong san leh na sanggampa a ngahkik na hi hi.
Ahi zongin na thu hong san keileh, ‘thu kici khempeuh teci nihlethum ii genkhiat kam tawh kip ding hi,’ a cih tawh kizui-in midang khatlenih tonpih in.
Amah in tua mite' thu a sannop keileh pawlpi ko in. Pawlpi' thu nangawn a sannop kei lai leh Gentile-te leh siahdongte bangin ngaihsun lel in.
“Maantak kong cihin ah leitunga na khih peuhpeuh uh vantung ah kikhih ding a, leitunga na phel peuhpeuh uh vantung ah kiphel ding hi.
Khatvei maantak kong cihkikin ah leitung ah note mi nih in na nget uh khatpeuh tawh kisai-in na kithukim nak uhleh vantunga om ka Pa in note' ading hong sepsak ding hi.
A hang pen keima' min tawh mi nihlethum a kimuhkhop uh ciangin amaute' lakah kei ka om hi.”
Tua ciangin Peter hong pai-in Jesu' kiangah, “Topa aw, kei' tunga hong khial ka sanggampa bangzah vei ka maisak ding hiam? Sagih vei dong ding hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Jesu in ama' kiangah hih bangin dawng hi: “Maisak in kong cih pen sagih vei hilo, sawmsagih mun sagih vei ding ahi hi.
“Tua hi a, vantung kumpigam pen a silate tawh sum malgualh a siangsak nuam kumpipa tawh kibang hi.
Siangsak ding a kipat laitak, ama' tungah talent thenkhat a ba mi khat hong kipaipih hi.
Tua silapa in a leiba loh zolo ahih manin amahmah leh a zi a ta-a kipan a neih khempeuh zuakin leiba a loh nadingin a topa in thupia hi.
Tua ciangin silapa leilak ah boksukin thum a, ‘Topa aw, hong ngak lai in. A vekpi-in kong pia ding hi,’ ci hi.
A topa in zong silapa hehpihhuai sa ahih manin amah khahin a leiba teng maisak hi.
“Ahih hangin tua silapa mah a paikhiat ciangin ama' tungah denarii zakhat a ba, a lawm sila dangte khat tawh kituak hi. Tua pa manin gawlmek a, ‘Nong leibat hong loh in,’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lawm silapa boksukin thum a, ‘Hong ngak lai in. Kong loh ding hi,’ ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in thumna nolhin a leiba a loh khit mateng thong ah khum dingin paipih hi.
A lawm sila dangte in tua thupiang teng a muh uh ciangin nakpi dah uh a, a topa uh' kiangah pai-in thupiang khempeuh va ko uh hi.
Tua ciangin a topa in tua silapa samin, ‘Nang sila ginalopa! Nong thum manin nong leibat khempeuh kong maisak hi.
Nang kong khual mah bangin na lawm silapa zong na khual ding kilawm hilo hiam?’ ci hi.
Tua ciangin a topa a hehsuak ahih manin a leiba teng a loh khit mateng gimthuak dingin thongcingte kiangah ap hi.
“Tua ahih manin nang zong lungsim takpi tawh na sanggampa na maisak keileh vantunga ka Pa in tua dan mahin nang' tungah hong bawl ding hi.”
